kinds.description: One budget spreadsheet held as a single ordinary record. Cells live in the text field cells_json, a JSON object mapping grid addresses (A1-Z99) to expression strings; a value with a leading '=' or a bare number is a formula, and disallowed characters are a syntax error. A formula may reference other cells and rectangular SUM ranges. Blank cells are not zero: a reference to an address absent from cells_json is refused rather than treated as 0. Cells_json is stored as written and validated on read by the host table-arithmetic operation, so a malformed field is preserved as source and reported per call.

fields.name: title

fields.name: cells_json
fields.description: JSON object mapping grid addresses (A1-Z99) to expression strings. Plain numbers and formulas joined by + - * / with parentheses and SUM(A1:B3) ranges. A reference to an absent cell is an error, not zero.
